new_promises.statement: Achieve growth of over 10% in sales volume for FY27 compared to last year.
new_promises.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year.
new_promises.speaker: Rahul Bharti

new_promises.statement: Spend INR 14,000 crores on capex for the full year FY27.
new_promises.quote: Overall, on the capex for FY 26-27, we are looking at a INR14,000 crores capex for the full year.
new_promises.speaker: Arnab Roy
